area.title: 面积图
area.sql:
SELECT sale_date AS 日期, SUM(amount) AS 销售额
FROM de_sales_wide
GROUP BY sale_date
ORDER BY 日期

area-stack.title: 堆叠面积图
area-stack.sql:
SELECT sale_date AS 日期, category_name AS 类别, SUM(amount) AS 销售额
FROM de_sales_wide
GROUP BY sale_date, category_name
ORDER BY 日期

bar.title: 柱状图
bar.sql:

FROM de_sales_wide

FROM daily_kpi WHERE metric_code = 'gmv'

radar.title: 雷达图
radar.sql:
SELECT province AS 地区,
  SUM(CASE WHEN channel = '电商平台' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS 电商,
  SUM(CASE WHEN channel = '线下门店' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS 线下,
  SUM(CASE WHEN channel = '企业直销' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS 直销
FROM de_sales_wide
GROUP BY province

table-info.title: 明细表
table-info.sql:
SELECT order_no AS 订单号, customer_name AS 客户, order_date AS 日期,
       order_status AS 状态, order_amount AS 金额, province_name AS 省份
FROM vs_official_order_detail
ORDER BY 日期 DESC
LIMIT 20
